package.name: cobot_detector
package.description:
C++ perception node running YOLO models exported to ONNX through ONNX Runtime. Pixel space only — no geometry, no millimeters.
action /vision/detect (Detect) run one model (by models.yaml id) on the latest color frame; result and /vision/detections_px carry pixel boxes stamped with the color frame used.
Models are declared in a bind-mounted models.yaml (runtime: / calibration: sections). OBB and plain bounding-box heads both produce ObbDetection — bbox models fill an axis-aligned rectangle with angle = 0.
ultralytics / torch are NOT dependencies of this package: training and the .pt → .onnx export happen offline in vision_workspace/tools. The core (onnx_detector, postprocess, letterbox, model_registry) has no ROS in it and is unit-tested on its own.
